## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run check` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] End-to-end tests pass (`npm run build && npm run test:e2e`) or aren’t affected
- [ ] Added a line under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md` for user-facing changes
- [ ] Database changes are a new migration (never edit a shipped one)
